name: Teaser loop
about: A still teaser brought to life as a seamless loop: it opens on the finished layout (so the first frame and thumbnail read at once), a generative field and the accent line move, the media drifts, and the last frame flows back into the first. Made for animated GIFs (LinkedIn, email, web) and muted autoplay loops.

slots.name: headline
slots.hint: the teaser's words; *word* is the focal word (accent colour and line), | breaks a line

slots.name: background
slots.hint: the brand's own background art (path); without it a generated field is drawn

slots.name: background_crop
slots.hint: [x0, y0, x1, y1] fraction of the background picture mapped onto the canvas; values past 0-1 leave the canvas colour showing

slots.name: background_opacity
slots.hint: 0.3 to 1: how strongly the background picture shows over the brand background colour (default 1)

slots.name: background_motion
slots.hint: wave (default): the picture stays still and a band of light travels outward from the focus, so a GIF stays small; breathe: the whole picture scales and turns slowly (video and WebM only: every pixel changes)

slots.name: background_feather
slots.hint: [top, right, bottom, left] fractions of the picture that fade into the canvas colour (default 0.07, 0.05, 0.07, 0.05); raise the side where the picture ends inside the canvas

slots.name: focus
slots.hint: [x, y] canvas fractions: the point the background breathes around and the ring pulses from

slots.name: media
slots.hint: an official product screen, photo or device picture from the brand kit (path); never edited

slots.name: media_box
slots.hint: [x, y, w] canvas fractions for the media

slots.name: media_edge
slots.hint: none (transparent cut-outs), fade (mockups on dark), card (bare screenshots)

slots.name: logo_box
slots.hint: [x, y, w] canvas fractions for the logo

slots.name: headline_box
slots.hint: [x, y, max width] canvas fractions for the headline

slots.name: headline_size
slots.hint: type size as a fraction of the canvas width (default 0.068)

slots.name: headline_leading
slots.hint: line height of the headline (default: the pack's display leading)

slots.name: field
slots.hint: generated accent field when there is no background picture
